steps.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render
Asset type: finished ROOF_OFF vehicle token for a top-down virtual tabletop.

TWO INPUTS WITH STRICTLY SEPARATE ROLES:
IMAGE 1 is an authored SVG-derived PLAN with deliberately measured internally consistent geometry. This is the AUTHORITATIVE camera, framing, body silhouette, wheelbase, hood/trunk lengths, cabin length, exact front and rear seat placement, seat sizes, steering wheel position and dashboard position. Paint THIS PLAN, preserving its layout rather than inventing a new car.
IMAGE 2 is a STYLE AND IDENTITY reference only: worn blue-green 1980s American sedan, one grey replacement driver's FRONT door, brown seats, realistic rusty industrial materials and crisp hand-painted RPG illustration. Do NOT copy image 2's perspective or use it to override the plan's geometry.

PRIMARY REQUEST
Transform the flat plan in image 1 into a richly hand-painted, believable, battered American sedan battle-map token, viewed strictly vertically from directly overhead, FRONT POINTING DOWN. Realistic forms and materials, painted dark outline, fine dust, chipped muted blue-green paint, rust around arches and seams. Grey front door on image-RIGHT. Keep the TWO measured rows of seating compact and coherent: TWO separate front brown bucket seats and ONE three-place brown rear bench. Exactly five seats, unoccupied.
Front seat positions must match image 1; the rear bench, dashboard and steering wheel must match image 1. A short natural rear footwell between the front-seat backs and the rear cushions, and a natural front footwell between front cushions and the dashboard; no long empty central hall, limousine gap, stretched seat rows or gigantic legroom. Ordinary vehicle seat and wheel dimensions all in ONE scale.

CUTAWAY
The entire upper cabin is hidden down to the door beltline: no roof, no roof rack, no luggage, no windshield glazing, no rear glazing, no side-window glass, no A/B/C pillars, no chrome window frames or raised metal perimeter fencing the opening. The narrow blue/grey shapes along the sides of the opening are LOWER DOOR BODYWORK and low interior door cards only. Preserve the enclosed hood and rear trunk from the plan. Steering wheel on image-RIGHT, down toward the dashboard/front. Keep all four tyres at their four guide locations; make them natural tucked-under-fender road wheels, not giant external off-road wheels.

FRAMING AND INVARIANTS
Same 1:2 portrait canvas and exact layout as image 1. Vehicle rear bumper near y3%, front bumper near y97%; body sides around x15% and x85%; wing mirrors around x10% and x90%. Cabin from approximately y29% to y71%. Front seat cushions around y55%, rear seat cushions around y39%. Preserve row spacing, no stretching the floor. Use the plan's geometry even if the original portrait suggests something different.
Replace the pale-grey reference backdrop with GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. No ground, road, scene, people, animals, passenger icons, cast ground shadow, grid, labels, lettering, numbers, logos, plates, rings, borders or watermark. Uniform neutral daylight from upper-left, soft self-shadow inside the body only. Final image is only the painted car on transparency, no blueprint graphics.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: correction of a vehicle token with an accidental third axle.

IMAGE 1 is the PAINTED EDIT TARGET. Its compact interior layout is good. Keep the body, cabin, seats, brown upholstery, dashboard, steering wheel, hood, trunk, mirrors, exhaust, paint, camera, canvas and transparent background unchanged.
IMAGE 2 is a GEOMETRY GUIDE ONLY for the intended FOUR road tyres, not a style reference.

The painted sedan currently has SIX visible tyres: an ordinary pair near the rear plus TWO separate front pairs. This is incorrect. A sedan must have EXACTLY TWO AXLES and FOUR TYRES IN TOTAL.

CHANGE ONLY THE TYRES / FRONT WHEEL-ARCH AREA:
- Keep ONE rear pair, left and right, centred at approximately 21% of image height.
- Replace the accidental double front wheels with ONE single front pair, left and right, centred at approximately 75% of image height, following image 2. Each front tyre is a single normal road tyre, about 12% of image height long and 3% of image width wide.
- There must be exactly one front tyre on the left and exactly one front tyre on the right. No other tyre near the mirrors, no second tyre further forward, no tandem wheels, no six-wheel conversion.
- Restore the blue-green front fender/body edge where the extra wheels are removed, keeping the hood closed and otherwise unchanged.
- Tyres remain realistically tucked into the fenders. Do not add wheels elsewhere.
Do not alter any seating position, legroom, body width, body length or cabin location. Keep the exact 1:2 front-DOWN overhead composition, same 887x1774 canvas, same transparent margin. No roof, glazing or pillars; no people, text, labels, numbers, symbols or background.

steps.purpose: Add roof/windows over the established cabin without changing seating
steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: matching ROOF_ON state of this exact ROOF_OFF sedan token.

Edit target: the supplied painted overhead sedan with a compact five-seat cabin.
Add the closed upper cabin and roof to THIS vehicle. Do not redesign or reposition the underlying car, seat rows, dashboard or steering wheel.

Keep the EXACT canvas dimensions, scale, centre, straight FRONT-DOWN 90-degree overhead camera, transparent margins, outer silhouette, mirrors, four tyre positions, trunk, hood, bumpers, exhaust, grey front driver's door on image-right and body weathering. A conventional sedan has exactly TWO AXLES and FOUR TYRES total.

The roof must fit the existing measured compact cabin, not force the cabin to change:
- Add the windshield in the FRONT of the existing cabin, immediately behind the hood/dashboard, approximately y53% to y65% of the canvas.
- Add the rear window at the REAR of the cabin, immediately ahead of the closed trunk, approximately y26% to y34%.
- Add an ordinary blue-green metal roof between those windows, approximately y34% to y53%; realistic narrow side window glazing and A/B/C pillars connect it to the existing lower door bodywork.
- Give the roof a small practical black steel rack with one modest olive canvas bundle and two brown straps, matching the established survivor car identity. The bundle must fit on the solid roof panel without covering either windshield.
- Glass is dusty dark grey with subtle reflections. If the seats, steering wheel or dashboard can be seen through any glass, those glimpses must show the EXACT SAME underlying seat shapes, positions and upholstery from the supplied roof-off image. Never invent a second seat position, never move a front seat to make it visible through glass. The roof hides furniture; it does not rearrange furniture.

Grounded crisp hand-painted RPG materials and muted neutral upper-left daylight, exactly matching the edit target. No occupants, weapons, road, ground, cast ground shadow, lettering, logos, numbers, plates, symbols, rings, frames or watermark. True transparent alpha. Change only the removable roof/window/pillar assembly and roof rack.
